question: If Shiva does not will, is there no descent-act — and whence concealment again?
premises: not 'Shiva wills thus' — in that act, in grace-descent, that would not happen
inference: Denied will blocks descent; concealment's re-arising is questioned.
plain_english: Not 'Shiva wills thus' — in that act, in grace-descent, that would not happen; and concealment named this — why would he arise again?
